execution_message.text:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: two-key-pose game action strip. Image 1 is the ONLY approved character master for identity/style. EXACTLY TWO equal-width horizontal slots LEFT TO RIGHT; one isolated full-body character in each, SAME drawing size/camera/head-body proportions and common source ground plane, generous transparent margins. Genuine alpha, no labels/panel dividers/floor/cast shadow/matte/motion blur. Do not overlap slot borders or clip any extremity. Preserve Soft Handmade 2.5D, warm dark-brown outline, controlled fine pencil/paper grain, soft SCREEN UPPER LEFT light. Do not draw any snack, tray, question mark, glitter, extra prop or duplicate character within a slot. Approved mint Dinosaur dinosaur-01: preserve large friendly tilted head, short rounded body, cream belly with EXACTLY TWO separate curved brown lines, soft yellow rounded dorsal spikes, peach cheeks, long curled tail, short stubby feet and toe marks. Dark round eyes without iris/sclera, each has LARGE primary at SCREEN upper-left (35% across, 28% down eye bounds), SMALL secondary lower-right. Magnifying glass stays in ANATOMICAL LEFT hand (viewer RIGHT), same orange/yellow frame and pale blue lens. Anatomical right hand stays free near chest; no snack/tray baked in. Same reference frontal three-quarter camera in both frames; friendly non-distressing movement. Pose 0 LEFT SLOT: gentle stumble/contact pose: torso leans slightly forward, one short foot extends forward to catch balance, other foot remains in support, free right hand slightly reaches for balance. Keep face and eyes recognizable, small uncertain w-shaped smile, no crying/damage/star effects. Pose 1 RIGHT SLOT: recovery pose, both short feet return to grounded stable stance, torso upright and friendly w-smile restored. Both complete full-body poses within margins, no flat lying pose or lost magnifier. Do not add extra belly lines, lengthen legs or radically tilt/enlarge head.

Revision for a separately authorized bounded retry: Keep the reference head camera, head silhouette, eye outline sizes, eye spacing and eye placement unchanged in BOTH poses. The gentle stumble is primarily a small free-hand and short-foot pose change; no head lean, enlargement or squash. Preserve the reference eye-to-head geometry and very small torso shift; pose change must not become an identity redesign. Keep each complete character near the center of its equal slot, with at least 10% clear transparent margin on the LEFT and RIGHT and generous margins above/below. No low-opacity haze, detached pixels or paint outside the character edge. Include the entire magnifier, tail, spikes and both feet; genuine clean transparent background. Use the same drawing size and baseline in both slots. Do not draw a snack.
